articles.title: Crypto analytics firm Chainalysis proposes standards for blockchain tracing
articles.snippet: The blockchain analysis company published a proposed ontology for how investigators can identify clusters of crypto addresses and link them together.

articles.title: Strategy opens door to selling billions of bitcoin under new capital plan. Here's what it means
articles.snippet: The company can now sell bitcoin to fund the USD reserve, support preferred dividends, and finance up to $2 billion in stock buybacks.

articles.title: Coinbase, Kraken and OKX move to swoop up EU users affected by MiCA restrictions
articles.snippet: Several exchanges that have already been authorized by EU regulators are attempting to bring in users from companies unlicensed under the Markets in Crypto-Assets rules, offering transfer bonuses and prizes.

articles.title: Germany leads MiCA crypto authorization race as Europe’s deadline looms
articles.snippet: MiCA crypto licensing data shows 244 approved companies across EU and EEA jurisdictions, led by Germany with France and the Netherlands also among top hubs ahead of July 1 cliff.

articles.title: BTC price RSI prints key 2026 signal: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.snippet: Bitcoin prepped an "interesting" RSI divergence into the Q2 and June candle close as analysis compared $60,000 to the $30,000 mark in the 2022 bear market.
